ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
RS1, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) symbols and indications as shown
on Map No. 9-1 in the area bound by:

West Irving Park Road; a line 52 feet west of and parallel to North Francisco
Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; and, a line
25.28 feet east of and parallel to North Richmond Street

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

a

Rossana Rodriguez Sanchez
Alderwoman, 33" Ward

Common Address:
2907-23 West Irving Park Road
